accessToken.description: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; kept in memory only.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

productCount.description: Current products that have it among their categories.

categories.description: The primary one first, hidden or deleted ones included.

previewUrl.description: Signed link to the original for 10 minutes; `null` when the storage could not sign it.

mustChangePassword.description: The user still has to replace a temporary password before using the rest of the panel.

imageAltTexts.description: One per image, in the same order; a missing or blank one means none.

code.description: Stable identifier of the error, such as `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`.

details.description: One entry per invalid field for VALIDATION_FAILED, or facts the client can show for some domain errors, such as `{ count }` or `{ field }`.

message.description: In Spanish, to show to the user.

path.description: The request path, without its query string.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

category.description: The primary category, or `null` while it is hidden from the store.

image.description: The first image with a public version.

price.description: Decimal text with two decimals, such as "1500.50".

salePrice.description: The running sale price, or `null` without a running sale.

stock.description: Units in stock; `0` when the product cannot be bought.

primaryCategory.description: `null` while the primary category is hidden from the store.

saleEndsAt.description: When the running sale ends, if it has an end.

field.description: Path of the field, such as `email` or `images.0`.

messages.description: In Spanish, to show next to the field.

info.description: REST API of the store and its admin panel. Errors share one body (`ErrorResponseDto`) with a stable `code`; messages are in Spanish, for the user.
